card.title: More Committed Than You
card.instruction: Treat belief in the scene’s strangest premise as a contest, proving your commitment through increasingly unnecessary demonstrations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You only bow to our invisible queen? I'm giving her my chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She already has an invisible throne.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine can support her feet. You hadn't considered her comfort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll give her my cushion, then. You can sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your cushion. She can have my bed. I'll sleep standing in case she calls.

mechanism: A turns respect for an invisible queen into a competition of escalating comfort sacrifices beyond B's offerings.
confusable: Unlike uncomplicated belief in the queen, A compares and outdoes B's demonstrations to prove superior commitment.
comparison: The queen alternative gives up furniture and sleep; the moon alternative enlarges a written pledge to outdo the other believer.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
